responsibility: This file provides tree-type-oriented optab selection and capability tests. It maps tree codes and type properties such as signedness, saturation, scalar-versus-vector form, and widening semantics to the appropriate optab, and it answers whether vector conversions, comparisons, conditional selects, and related tree operations are supportable on the current target, also initializing per-optimization-node optab snapshots when target options can alter tree-level expansion decisions.
same_name_distinction: Implements the tree-facing half of the optabs-tree stem declared in gcc/optabs-tree.h: it maps tree codes and type properties to specific optabs, answers whether tree/vector operations are supportable, and initializes per-optimization-node optab snapshots. Unlike the header, this file performs the actual tree-code/type-to-optab decision logic.
